Initial fence display has the moon and paper sun plus unspecified flags. Later loaf, red square and blue star belong to later membership phases, not this adding event or the early every-flag visibility claim.
Additional arriving helpers are distinct from the earlier helpers already setting out tables; no whole-group arrival is inferred.
